alert.title: RAID array degraded (md0)
alert.message: md0 (RAID10) is running degraded: 1 of 6 devices failed (/dev/sdd). Array is still online; rebuild has not started (no spare).
alert.recommendation: Replace /dev/sdd and re-add it to the array, then watch the rebuild. If you operate this hardware (owned or colocated): handle the inspection or swap yourself, or dispatch a remote-hands technician. If this is rented or provider-managed: file a hardware service ticket with your provider. Either way, the physical check needs to happen on-site.
